notes: **Fixed `migrate_layout()` Step 5 silent non-convergence on directory conflicts.** Sibling to the v2.5.3 file-conflict fix. When a shipped directory (`scripts/`, `reference-notes/`) exists at BOTH `.gator/<dir>/` AND `.gator/.includes/<dir>/`, Step 5's merge loop branched only on `f.is_dir() and not dest_f.exists()` — no `else` for the both-exist case. So if `.gator/scripts/__pycache__/` existed at src AND dest, both survived; `src_dir.rmdir()` failed silently (except OSError: pass), layout re-detected as `mixed`, `--migrate-layout` reported "Result: mixed (migration incomplete — check conflicts)" and never converged. Manual cleanup (`rm -rf .gator/scripts/__pycache__ .gator/scripts/hooks`) was required per repo. Issue #6, discovered on `code/donoriq`.

**Fix**: added explicit `elif f.is_dir()` branch handling the both-exist case. Known-safe legacy names (`__pycache__`, `hooks`) get `shutil.rmtree`'d unconditionally — bytecode is regenerated on next Python invocation; `hooks/` is pre-monorepo git-hook install residue that `install_git_hooks()` no longer writes to. Everything else routes through the new `_merge_dir_files_only()` helper: recursive files-only merge, dest wins on collision (matches Step 4's SHIPPED_ROOT_FILES rule), any unresolvable residue (non-file/non-dir entries; subdirs still holding content) logged into `report["conflicts"]`.

**Sync-obligation**: applied identically to `src/gator_command/scripts/gator-update.py` (wheel) and `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/scripts/gator-update.py` (fleet mirror). Cross-file diff (excluding the pre-existing entry-point inlining divergence) confirmed empty — verified with `git diff --no-index --stat`.

**Regression pins**: `tests/test_layout.py::TestMigration::test_shipped_dir_pycache_conflict_removed` (the known-safe legacy path — pycache and hooks both present at src, both removed, canonical `.includes/` bytecode untouched) and `test_shipped_dir_unknown_dir_conflict_merges` (unknown-name subdir goes through `_merge_dir_files_only`; shared file dest-wins, root-only file moved, src dir gone). All 8 `TestMigration` cases pass.

**Charter updates**: `scripts-repo-lifecycle.md` — added `_merge_dir_files_only` charter entry with tripwires (unbounded recursion caller-guarded by SHIPPED_DIRECTORIES; `mkdir(exist_ok=True)` safe by call site invariant); extended `migrate_layout` tripwire with the Issue #6 explanation and regression-pin references.

Part of the "update and begin-session bugs" fix set (plan: `.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-03-update-and-begin-session-bugs-implementation-plan.md`, step A1 of B1→B2→A1→A4→A2→B3→A3). Unblocks Dashboard Update on fleet repos that carry `.gator/scripts/__pycache__/` or `.gator/scripts/hooks/` residue — every fleet repo that has run a Python script under its own `.gator/scripts/`.
